Start cycling wallpapers from a directory

Usage: wayle wallpaper cycle [OPTIONS] <DIRECTORY>

Arguments:
  <DIRECTORY>
          Directory containing wallpaper images

Options:
  -i, --interval <INTERVAL>
          Interval in seconds between changes
          
          [default: 300]

  -m, --mode <MODE>
          Cycling mode

          Possible values:
          - sequential: Cycle in alphabetical order
          - shuffle:    Cycle in random order
          
          [default: sequential]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
